# Agent Mail

AgentMail provides programmable email inboxes, messages, drafts, domains, webhooks, and related infrastructure for AI agents.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/agent-mail/.

## Actions

- **Get Message**: Get a specific message from an agentmail inbox
- **List Messages**: List messages from an agentmail inbox
- **Send Email**: Send an email using agentmail api
